title: Ephemeral Collab Stamp & Effort Index — May 2026
summary: Quick, lightweight roster and effort-index to surface who can cover short ad-hoc cross-team asks (next 7 days). Not a replacement for rota but intended to be a fast snapshot used during bursts, launch days, or region fallbacks.
